derivation: amendment A6: the first rel=canonical link in document order is the page's canonical. A's first canonical is B (non-self); the later canonical to A does not replace it, so `hreflang_canonical_not_self`.

files.a.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://beta.example/b">
<link rel="canonical" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://beta.example/b">
</head><body></body></html>
files.b.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://beta.example/b">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://beta.example/b">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://alpha.example/a">
</head><body></body></html>

name: canonical-first-wins
